issues.description: README links a config path that does not exist in the recipe
issues.detail: README references ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml but the file lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and misdocuments the very artifact it advertises. Fix the path.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit
issues.detail: Under set -euo pipefail, the script echoes that unzip is missing then continues and later invokes unzip, dying with a cryptic error. The precondition check is theater. Either exit non-zero on the missing tool or remove the check.

issues.description: Usage block prints then falls through without exit on wrong argc
issues.detail: When $# is out of [1,2], the script cats usage but does not exit, falling into realpath $1 with possibly no args. Under set -u this dies obscurely instead of returning a clean usage failure. Add exit 1 after the heredoc.

issues.description: Unquoted realpath arguments break under whitespace or empty values
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted under set -u. Paths with spaces split into multiple words and empty values crash obscurely. Quote them: realpath "$1" and realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}".

issues.description: Transcript normalization is an opaque sed chain with no documented target alphabet
issues.detail: data.sh strips full-width punctuation and one Cyrillic A via successive sed calls intertwined with file plumbing. There is no specified legal-character set tied to the tokenizer and no invariant that the substitution table is complete. Extract the rules into a named mapping file or python script.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts couple the recipe to one dataset snapshot
issues.detail: data.sh aborts on wc -l mismatches against magic numbers (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924) embedded in a heredoc. Benign upstream dataset changes will break the recipe with no actionable path. Move counts to a named manifest with a dataset-version citation, or downgrade to a warning.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a standard ESPnet bootcamp recipe contribution that is mostly boilerplate but ships sloppy supporting shell. Three reviewers independently flagged the broken README config path, the missing-unzip warning that does not exit, and unquoted/non-terminating argument handling in download_and_untar.sh under set -euo pipefail. The transcript normalization in data.sh is an opaque sed chain with no documented target alphabet, and hard-coded utterance counts will break on any benign upstream dataset change. Fixes are small and obvious; needs-work before merge.
